fields.coded: ...escape on an even chance if the rules mark it as crewed; no page read says whether they do.
fields.fix: Rewrite: 'The reference Rules.ini marks the minelayer Crewed, so by UNIT.CPP one civilian technician escapes on an even chance. Basis stays proposal under the registry's game-wide note (no cited page shows the flag) unless the lead accepts the reference copy for Crewed; then basis in-game, with an uncertain entry at on_death.' The outcome stays bail-out.

skeptic.fix: Rewrite on_death.notes along these lines: 'No cited page shows its crew getting out, so the registry's rule keeps the 3C default. The reference copy of Rules.ini (OpenRA raclassic), read for the Tracked flag, also marks the minelayer as crewed. By UNIT.CPP, a crewed vehicle with no passenger seats lets one crewman out on an even chance, with part of his health: a civilian technician here, since it carries no weapon. The registry notes leave using that copy for the Crewed flag to the lead.' Keep outcome bail-out and basis proposal. If the lead accepts the copy for Crewed, change the basis to in-game and add an uncertain entry at on_death naming the copy.
